title: kate-ui: return OpenFailed when a new view is missing
summary: make_new no longer calls expect on new_view. A missing view returns OpenFailed. A view that exists still returns Ready. Linux CI runs the helper test.

lane.reason: The helper has no GPUI type. Linux CI runs that test. The existing file tests stay on macos-15. The packet does not enable gpui-tests.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add effect_for_new_view. None returns OpenFailed. Some returns Ready. make_new calls that function with ws.new_view(doc). make_new has no expect. The document from new_document stays when the view is missing. The existing New test still expects Ready. The helper test is cfg(test) and it builds on Linux. It does not construct a Workspace. Leave session.rs and lib.rs unchanged. This packet does not enable the gpui-tests feature. Leave layout.rs and notice.rs unchanged. PKT-0069 owns those files. Leave paint.rs unchanged. PKT-0071 owns that file. Leave fold.rs and view.rs unchanged. PKT-0073 owns those files. Leave command.rs and workspace.rs unchanged. PKT-0074 owns those files. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.
